name: Jumbo Smoked Turkey Leg (High Sodium/Fat Warning)
whyItWorks: Though turkey is lean, Disney's giant cured dark-meat legs are brined in heavy sodium nitrate solutions, smoked with skin-on, and contain significant rendered subcutaneous grease that can trigger severe intestinal cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sodium & Grease Warning: Peel off and discard all outer dark skin and fat; consume only small portions of inner lean meat.
